# Offline PDF.js rendering assets
These unmodified build files are from the Apache-2.0-licensed pdfjs-dist
NPM distribution, version 5.4.624, pinned for SkyFire Safety v0.19.
Source: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
Do not load the renderer from a public CDN at runtime; both files must
be cached by the SkyFire service worker before offline use.
Original MSHA PDFs remain separately available for download and filing.
Interactive/XFA forms may need an external compatible PDF reader.
See LICENSE and SHA256SUMS.
